channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: 49ers RB Kaelon Black (illness) is not on the final injury report for Week 5 against the Seahawks.
item.description: Black was limited on Wednesday, but upgraded to full participation on Thursday and Friday. There are no concerns about his ability to handle backup duties against the Seahawks this week. That said, he has just 10 carries over the last two weeks and cannot be started in 12-team FLEX spots.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Isaiah Likely (knee/groin) is not on the final injury report and will play in Week 5 against the Commanders.
item.description: The Giants’ passing offense is tethered to Jameis Winston’s scattershot arm, but Likely has a favorable matchup against the Commanders’ defense this week. He can be started as a low-end TE1 in this divisional showdown.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Mike Evans (ribs) is not on the final injury report and will play in Week 5 against the Seahawks.
item.description: The 49ers’ star wide receiver is good to go for his team’s Week 5 game against a divisional rival. A hard hit to the midsection could change his day, but Evans is extremely tough and should be expected to handle his normal workload. He is a weekly WR2, operating as San Francisco’s passing game focal point.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: 49ers ruled out Nick Bosa (knee/calf) for Week 5 against the Seahawks.
item.description: The 49ers will be without Bosa, FB Kyle Juszczyk (knee), DL James Thompson Jr. (ankle) and S Marques Sigle (ankle) for this divisional showdown, making life a little easier on their opponent.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: 49ers DL Mykel Williams (knee) is questionable for Week 5 against the Seahawks
item.description: Williams is officially listed as questionable, though he is expected to take the field for the first time since tearing his ACL in Week 9, during this 2025 rookie season. His return could not have come soon enough. The 49ers’ defensive line has been hit hard by injuries this year. The 49ers correspondingly released DL Ogbo Okoronkwo to make room on the active roster.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Broncos signed WR Lil’Jordan Humphrey off their own practice squad.
item.description: Every year it somehow comes to this. Humphrey will replace Pat Bryant (IR/ankle) on the 53-man roster. We expect Troy Franklin and Marvin Mims will have more opportunities than Humphrey to actually catch the ball.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Seahawks DT Leonard Williams (ankle)is not on the final injury report and will play in Week 5 against the 49ers.
item.description: The Seahawks will have their stud interior defender on hand against the division-rival 49ers. They will be without backup CB Julian Neal (hamstring), who suffered an injury in practice.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Cardinals DT Walter Nolen (calf) is questionable for Arizona’s Week 5 game against the Lions.
item.description: Nolen was limited in back-to-back practices after popping up with the calf listing on Thursday. He’s played 319 snaps in 21 career opportunities so far.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Seahawks RB George Holani (ribs/knee) is questionable to play in Week 5 against the 49ers.
item.description: Holani was nursing a ribs injury on Wednesday and Thursday, but he is now listed with a knee injury as well. This is concerning. He clearly picked up a new injury during the practice week. Velus Jones is the current RB3. Jones is not viable as a FLEX starter if Holani sits, but Emanuel Wilson should take on an RB2-worthy workload regardless.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is not on Arizona’s final Week 5 injury report.
item.description: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur said “It’s a maintenance thing with ankles, you guys see the way he cuts...I don’t know what he’s totally feeling, only he knows...but he’s doing good.” Great, not cryptic at all, Mike. Love is a reasonable low-end RB2 if his ankles decide he wants to play his full allotment of the 50/50 split against the Lions in Week 5.-Rivers McCown
